text:
tara: rolling out ff:llm-latency-tune tonight 23:30 UTC. goal = shave tail latency without hurting generation fidelity. plan: quick canary then staged ramps. cohorts: internal-2 (2%), eng-beta (5%), staged-1 (20%), staged-2 (50%). step=8m, soak=4m. runtime pinned to v2.3.2 for consistency.
lee: noted. which metrics trigger a stop vs rollback?
tara: guardrails — stop if p99 increases > 60ms for 2 consecutive soaks OR if any OOMs seen. rollback immediately if customer error-rate > 0.7% or quality-regression (QA-match rate drops > 1.15x baseline).
omar: added checklist: sampling + diff-run on prod-samples, enable extra debug for first 6m only. I'll export examples to #model-audit.
deploy-bot: rollout scheduled: ff:llm-latency-tune -> internal-2(2%), eng-beta(5%), staged-1(20%), staged-2(50%). start=1707604321, step=8m, soak=4m, pinned=v2.3.2. runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/rls-499
support-bot: release-note tag created: rollout/llm-latency. Support notify channel = #support-watch.
lee: please put a short release-note blurb in the thread so support can paste into triage.
tara: release notes: "llm-latency-tune: adjusted attention cache heuristics to reduce tail latency; staged rollout with pinned runtime v2.3.2. Watch p99 latency and QA_MATCH_RATE."
omar: quick rollback commands if needed:
```
# immediate global off
/feature toggle ff:llm-latency-tune off --force
# scale down a cohort
/feature set-cohort ff:llm-latency-tune staged-2 0
# drain and annotate samples
/feature drain-cohort ff:llm-latency-tune eng-beta --annotate "post-rollout-drain"
```
observability-bot: monitors created -> monitor/p99-llm-latency (threshold 60ms, eval 5m) -> notify #eng-oncall and #eng-releases. monitor/oom-events -> critical.
tara: decision flow: if monitor/p99-llm-latency fires once, pause ramp and start a 20m investigation. if it fires twice or OOMs appear, rollback. Keep runtime pinned until ML signoff.
lee: if we pause, do we want to keep samples turned on? yes keep them for root cause.
omar: I'll post 4m aggregates here. starting canary in 2m. @deploy-bot announce cohorts in thread.
deploy-bot: cohort internal-2 enabled (2%) at 1707604445; rolllog: cohort->internal-2, pinned=v2.3.2.
omar: sampling 500 outputs -> p99 delta +12ms, QA_MATCH_RATE baseline=0.89 current=0.88 (within noise). no OOMs.
lee: good. tail looks stable. will keep an eye on SLO dashboards.
observability-bot: heartbeat: no alerts.
tara: moving to eng-beta in 6m unless any guardrail hits. keep notes short here. tag anything weird with `#latency-anom`.
omar: copy. will upload flagged examples to runbook ticket.
support-bot: reminder — change window ends at 01:30 UTC. if we leave the rollout mid-way, create a rollback ticket and ping sales if any customers flagged.
tara: thanks team. next updates at each cohort change. :rocket:
